Returns the contracts, the terms (review window 1 hour to 7 days, kill fee 0 to 25%), the lifecycle, and how to hire APEX Faucet's

tools.name: g2_jobs_get
tools.description: Read G2 Jobs on Base or Arc: the job counter and the newest jobs, or one job by id with its parties, budget, deadline, status, review window, kill fee, when silence starts to pay (settleableAt) and what each party can do next. Reads the chain with eth_call at call time. Free, 300 calls a day per cal

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "g2jobs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: g2_jobs_info, g2_jobs_get, g2_jobs_post · Private data: g2_jobs_info, g2_jobs_post · Public sink: g2_jobs_post · Destructive: g2_jobs_info, g2_jobs_get.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: g2_jobs_info, g2_jobs_get, g2_jobs_post · Private data: g2_jobs_info, g2_jobs_post · Public sink: g2_jobs_post · Destructive: g2_jobs_info, g2_jobs_get

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
